title: Nanophase REE phosphate crystallization induced by vivianite oxidation: mechanistic insights and mineralogical implications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,11257-11270

M. Maddin, L. Terribili, R. Rateau, A. M. Szucs, J. D. Rodriguez-Blanco
Our study investigates the interaction between multi-component rare earth element (REE; La, Ce, Pr, Nd, Dy)-bearing aqueous solutions and vivianite (Fe32+(PO4)2·8H2O) grains under hydrothermal conditions (50–165 °C).
